texts.zh: 尽管我们在星系中算不上真正的超级大国，我们却时常能在星系事务中发挥超过我国权重的实力。这在很大程度上归功于我们使者[event_envoy.GetName]的努力，这名特使在星海共同体中称职地代表了我国利益，连那些强硬反对[Root.GetName]立场的人们也对其高度尊敬。结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的金库，但他们依然景仰我国外交使团的高超造诣。
texts.en: Although we are not able to count ourselves among the true superpowers of this galaxy, we have often been able to punch above our weight in galactic affairs. This is largely down to the exertions of our emissary [event_envoy.GetName], who ably represents our interests in the Galactic Community and commands deep respect even among those stridently opposed to all the [Root.GetName] stands for. As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the depths of our coffers, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic corps.
